items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: Ben, my saxophone player, is really a great teacher.

ctx.x: Ben Richardson. So he's really a great teacher. I mean, he knows how to teach it correctly and all of that and I would always give them to him. I would give him a lot of -- they would come to me, like you know, like they'd see me being a band leader and everything. They says, "Have you got time to teach me?" I'd tell them I would like to, but I really don't have the time, you know? And that's
why I really haven't gotten into it. I really can't teach my children. They taken lessons over in the schools, you know. I guy them the instruments and they take lessons with the school.
